Shpykiv Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. In 1885, the Hasidic tzaddikim of Chernobyl settled in Shpykiv, and Menachem Nochum Twersky — founder of the Chernobyl dynasty's Makariv branch, documented elsewhere in this collection — personally blessed this cemetery. The writer Johanan Twersky, likely connected to that same rabbinic family, was born in Shpykiv in 1900. Under Romanian occupation, the town's Jews were expelled to the Rogozna camp and then to Pechera, documented elsewhere in this collection, on December 18, 1941; 539 more were tortured and murdered on August 19, 1943.
